svg.aria-label: werkrbee ai-hive architecture: the House of Hives
svg.title: werkrbee ai-hive — Architecture (House of Hives)
svg.desc: Humans set the charter and goals; Patricia governs and Barry executes across the six artifact hives, which plugins-hive bundles and projects-hive stamps out into products that run on every harness. An assurance loop wraps the agents, and Patricia and Barry are hosted on Azure from hives/agents-hive/deploy/azure.
svg.text: A harness-agnostic factory for AI agent products: build the reusable layers once, stamp out products from them.
Own the house: set goals, approve consequential
The six artifact hives · hives/ · one portable artifact each
